create.name: Tanya Carroll Richardson
create.bio:
Tanya Carroll Richardson is a professional intuitive and author whose work centres on angels, intuition and the inner lives of sensitive people. She spent many years as a working writer and editor before her first book appeared, and since 2016 she has contributed regularly to MindBodyGreen. Her books, from Llewellyn, Hachette, Simon & Schuster and Union Square & Co, include Angel Intuition, Empath Heart, Self-Care for Empaths and Are You an Earth Angel?, and she has also created oracle decks for Insight Editions and a page-a-day self-love calendar.

In private sessions she draws on what she calls the four clairs, taking in guidance by hearing, seeing, knowing and feeling, and she works chiefly with angels, oracle cards and messages from people who have died. Readings last ninety minutes, begin after she has spent twenty minutes meditating on the client, and are held by phone or Zoom, with a recording sent on afterwards. She also offers shorter angel energy clearings, a four-step process on Zoom in which she calls on three archangels, as well as mentoring for writers who hope to publish. Each month she posts an oracle card reading on her YouTube channel.

books.title: Angel Intuition: A Psychic's Guide to the Language of Angels
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: A guide to recognising and working with angelic guidance through the intuitive senses. Published by Llewellyn in 2018.

books.title: Are You an Earth Angel?: Understand Your Sensitive & Empathic Nature & Live with Divine Purpose
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: Written for highly sensitive and empathic readers who feel they have a spiritual calling. It looks at the traits of these people and at how they might find and live their purpose.

books.title: Empath Heart: Relationship Strategies for Sensitive People
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: Practical advice for sensitive people on friendships, family ties and romantic partnerships. Published by Sterling, now Union Square & Co, in 2023.

books.title: Love Notes to My Self: Meditations and Inspirations for Self-Compassion and Self-Care
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: A small book of short reflections and affirmations on treating oneself kindly. Published by Workman in 2022.

books.title: Zen Teen: 40 Ways to Stay Calm When Life Gets Stressful
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: Forty simple practices for teenagers who want more calm and steadiness in daily life. Published by Seal Press in 2018.

books.title: Self-Care for the Soul: 111 Exercises, Rituals & Invitations for Spiritual Well-Being
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: Her newest book, from Amber Lotus and Andrews McMeel in November 2026. It gathers short exercises and rituals for tending one's spiritual life.

books.title: Awakening Intuition: Oracle Deck and Guidebook
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: An illustrated oracle deck with a guidebook, made to help users notice signs and strengthen their sixth sense. Published by Insight Editions in 2023.

books.title: The Comforting Wisdom Oracle
books.author: Tanya Carroll Richardson
books.description: A 64-card deck with a guidebook, arranged in three suits named Nurture, Ground and Dream. Its theme is cosiness and looking after oneself through change.

courses.title: Intuitive Readings with Tanya
courses.description: A ninety-minute private reading by phone or Zoom audio, for which she meditates on the client beforehand. She works with angels, oracle cards and loved ones who have passed, and sends a recording afterwards.

courses.title: Angel Energy Clearings
courses.description: A shorter one-to-one session on Zoom in which she takes the client through a four-step clearing of their energy field with three archangels. It ends with grounding and centring.
